conventions: יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת → 'the sabbath day' throughout the chapter (13.15, 17, 19, 22): the rectum's article takes the phrase's single fronted 'the', שַׁבָּת takes the attributive 'sabbath', יוֹם takes 'day'. The same fronting reads בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים → 'the house of God' (13.7, 9, 11) and קֻרְבַּן הָעֵצִים → 'the wood offering' (13.31).

Head choices where rule 31 ties on a two-word rendering of one substantive: מִנְחָה → 'meal offerings' heads on 'meal' (13.5, 9), תְּרוּמָה → 'heave offerings' on 'heave' (13.5), בִּכּוּרִים → 'first fruits' on 'first' (13.31), while תִּירוֹשׁ → 'new wine' heads on 'wine' (13.5, 12) because the ASV writes a bare 'wine' for יַיִן in 13.15 and 'new' is its specifier. The other reading is named in each unit's note.

Hiphil בּוֹא rendered 'bring in' / 'brought in' / 'there should be brought in' keeps the particle 'in' inside the verb's unit (13.15, 16, 19); it is not added, since the hiphil's bringing-in is what the particle restates.

The refrain זָכְרָה־לִּי אֱלֹהַי is read off the ASV each time: לִּ unrepresented where the ASV writes a bare 'Remember me' (13.14, 31), aligned to 'unto' where it writes 'Remember unto me' (13.22); the suffix takes 'me', אֱלֹהַ takes 'O God' with the vocative 'O' (rule 36), and the paragogic he is unrepresented.
report: Read all 31 verses end to end against the 63-lemma candidate table. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the ASV's own wording: waw takes whichever connective is written (and/Then/But/yet/or/howbeit/therefore/So/Thus/then/also/as/which/so that) and is unrepresented only where the ASV opens bare (13.5 sentence continuation, 13.19 apodosis, 13.24 distributive pair); לְ and בְּ take the preposition written or go unrepresented where the object is promoted (13.7 'understood the evil', 13.22 'commanded the Levites', 13.20 'without Jerusalem').

Recurring constructions are analysed one way throughout: יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת → 'the sabbath day' with the rectum's article taking the fronted 'the' (13.15, 17, 19, 22); בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים → 'the house of God' with the article fronted one level (13.7, 9, 11) and a supplied 'the' on the construct where no article stands (13.4, 14); arthrous recta 'the tithe(s) of the grain', 'the portions of the Levites' counted per rule 29; hiphil בּוֹא → 'bring in'/'brought in' keeps the particle with the verb (13.15, 16, 19); assimilated articles take a written 'the' and go unrepresented beside a pronoun's 'that/those' (13.1, 15, 23); every cohortative/paragogic he unrepresented; every object marker H853 unrepresented and every H854 'with' aligned.

Supplied relatives are consistent with the contract's boundary: 'who' (13.16) and 'that' (13.23) are added over a finite clause or a circumstantial participle juxtaposed to a written antecedent (rule 55), while 'who was appointed' (13.4) stays with the passive participle standing immediately after its noun with none of rule 41's four predication marks; the verse pass named the competing reading. Not read as a split, since a finite clause intervenes in 13.16 and none does in 13.4.

Interrogative particle: 13.18 gives the second clause's auxiliary 'did' to הֲ under rule 25 while the first clause's 'Did' is עָשׂוּ itself (English 'do thus'); 13.26 and 13.27 give the fronted auxiliary to הֲ. Consistent with rule 17.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences (Td agreement/assimilated articles, dative and promoted-object prepositions, cohortative he, object marker אוֹתוֹ where גַּם holds the 'even', the אֵין subject suffix the ASV writes no pronoun for). None is a genuine error and no edge was changed.
No amendment or promotion: the chapter taught nothing the contract does not already state.
